raw_response:
A is ill-posed as a bridge back to Window6/Fibonacci.
The core reason is simple: “first-order” is not an invariant notion unless the product frame is fixed.
For codons, the frame is canonical:

$$H(3,4)=V_4^3.$$

Here  $E_1$  means additive dependence on one codon position, with each position carrying the chemical characters of the four bases. So the certified localization to position 3, position 1, weak/strong, and purine/pyrimidine is meaningful. It says the bio residual lives in single-position codon chemistry: wobble and base-pairing.
Window6 lives in a different frame:

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},\quad |X_6|=21,$$

inside the Boolean cube  $Q_6$ , or as the Fibonacci cube  $\Gamma_6$ . Its natural spectral decompositions are Boolean Fourier degree on six bits, or graph spectrum of  $\Gamma_6$ . Boolean degree 1 means one bit. Codon  $E_1$  means one four-state codon position. These are not the same object.
You can define a clean Window6 diagnostic:

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64,$$

with Boolean Fourier expansion

$$f_W=\sum_{S\subseteq[6]}\hat f(S)\chi_S,$$

and degree-energy profile

$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\ne\varnothing}\hat f(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\ldots,6.$$

A fair null would be all 21-vertex subsets of  $Q_6$  with internal edge count 38, preferably also matching the coordinate-marginal multiset. If Window6 is extreme for  $\rho_1$ ,  $\rho_2$ , or high-degree energy, that certifies a property of Window6 as a Boolean constraint.
But it does not certify alignment or contravariance with codon  $E_1$ . To compare with  $V_4^3$ , you must group six Boolean bits into three pairs and interpret each pair as one four-state coordinate. That grouping is not forced by Window6. If chosen because it makes the result attractive, it is convention-circular. If all 15 pairings behave alike, the result is generic to Window6 or to its size/edge profile, not a codon bridge. If only some pairings work, it is not label-free.
So the only legitimate role of the Window6 Fourier calculation is a negative-control appendix:
Window6 has its own Boolean spectral profile, but no canonical morphism identifies that profile with codon  $E_1$ .
That means A is not a non-circular, non-vacuous bridge step. It is a sanity check, not discovery.
The honest answer to B is:
the bridge is correctly bio-gated.
There is no remaining pure-math or public-data step that can non-vacuously connect the certified codon- $E_1$  residual back to Window6/Fibonacci. The structural program is genuinely exhausted as a bridge program.
The important conclusion is bounded but strong: the hoped-for  $E_3$  spectral bridge failed. The actual bio-intrinsic residual sits in ordinary first-order codon chemistry. That is biologically plausible and worth testing, but it is not a Fibonacci signature.
The decisive next input is the expanded organism set for the held-out cross-organism gate.
The sharpest next question is: In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain reproducible after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
